headword: {救命胴衣|きゅうめいどうい}

definitions.explanation: A buoyant vest worn to keep a person afloat in water: on boats and ferries, in fishing, and stowed under airplane seats. The formal and official term; in everyday speech ライフジャケット is also common.

examples.japanese: {救命胴衣|きゅうめいどうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: To put on a life jacket.

examples.japanese: {救命胴衣|きゅうめいどうい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Your life vest is located under your seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{救命胴衣|きゅうめいどうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}している→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Before getting on the boat, we checked that everyone was wearing a life jacket.

notes:
⟦{救命|きゅうめい}→救命：12927_kyuumei⟧ (lifesaving) + {胴衣|どうい} (vest, a garment for the torso). Heard in airplane safety announcements and seen on ferries and boat-rental signs.
